title: Resurrection and Divine Authority
english: ...to bring me you out of your tombs, my people; and I will give spirit into you, and you will live.
For he will go up into heavens; David says in the Psalm: 'God went up with a shout, the Lord with the sound of a trumpet.' (Psalm 68:15)
Amos says: 'The one building his ascent into heaven.' (Amos 9:6)

Isaiah says: 'The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he anointed me; to evangelize the poor, he sent me; to proclaim release to captives and sight to the blind; to call the acceptable year of the Lord; and the day of recompense to our God.' (Isaiah 61:1-2)
And again: 'My people will know my name in that day; I am the one speaking; I am present as a messenger of peace; making the salvation of you to be heard.' (Isaiah 52:6)
Zechariah says: 'Those who remain from all the nations will go up year by year to worship the Lord of hosts.' (Zechariah 14:16)
Ezekiel says: 'I will cleanse you, and I will give my Spirit into you.' (Ezekiel 36:25)
And again: 'I will give them another heart and a new Spirit I will give to them.' (Ezekiel 36:26)
David says in the Psalm: 'His sound went out into all the earth, and to the ends of the world his words.' (Psalm 19:4)
Jeremiah says: 'I will give them another way and another heart to fear me all my days.' (Jeremiah 32:39)
Isaiah says: 'I saw the Lord sitting on a high throne.' (Isaiah 6:1)
David says: 'Your throne is prepared, Lord, and from eternity you are.' (Psalm 93:2)
And again: 'The Lord says to my Lord: Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.' (Psalm 110:1)
And Isaiah says: 'The heaven is my throne, and the earth is the footstool of my feet.' (Isaiah 66:1)
And again: Nations will see your glory and all kings your righteousness, and he will be called by a new name, which the Lord will name for him. (Isaiah 62:2)
And again: To those who serve him, a new name will be called, which will be blessed upon the earth. (Isaiah 65:15)
David says in the Psalm: 'You have given a sign to those who fear you to flee from the face of the bow.' (Psalm 112:7)
And Isaiah says: 'Those who are being sealed will be manifest to know the law.' (Isaiah 66:18)

And Ezekiel says: 'The Lord said to the man clothed in linen, give the sign upon the foreheads of the men who sigh and groan over all the iniquities, and go through the middle of Jerusalem.' (Ezekiel 9:4)
baehrens: PG 41-43; Testimonia ex divinis et sacris scripturis (Khazarzar) u03 rem early
translator_notes: The text begins mid-sentence: τοῦ ἀναγαγεῖν με ὑμᾶς ἐκ τῶν τάφων ὑμῶν λαός μου
The clause 'ἐκ δεξιῶν τοῦ Πατρὸς οὐκ ἀφ' οὗ ἀνῆλθεν ἐκάθισεν, ἀλλὰ καὶ πρὸ τούτου' is a theological commentary on the eternal nature of the throne, not a direct quotation from Psalm 89:2.

title: Destruction and Judgment
english: The Lord commands: strike and do not spare, do not have mercy; destroy older men, young men, women, and nursing infants—leave none alive.
And on all who bear my sign, do not draw near.
For the baptism in Christ was proclaimed beforehand.
Isaiah says: 'Wash yourselves, make yourselves clean, put away the evil of your doings from before my eyes' (Isaiah 1:16).

Isaiah also says: 'On that day the Lord will shine forth in counsel with glory on the earth to exalt and glorify the remnant of Israel in Zion and Jerusalem, for all who are written for life in Jerusalem shall be called holy' (Isaiah 4:2-3).
The Lord will wash away the filth of the sons and daughters of Zion and cleanse the blood of Jerusalem from her midst by a spirit of judgment and a spirit of burning (Isaiah 4:4).
And it shall come to pass that every place of Mount Zion and all her assembly shall be shaded by a cloud by day and a smoke and flaming fire by night (Isaiah 4:5-6).
The Jewish baptism according to the law also bears witness to this.
For the second coming was proclaimed beforehand.

Malachi says: 'Behold, the Lord comes like a refiner's fire and like fullers' soap; he will sit as a refiner and purifier of silver, and he will purify the sons of Levi and refine them like gold and silver, that they may offer to the Lord an offering in righteousness' (Malachi 3:2-3).

And again he says: 'Then I will draw near to you for judgment; I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, against the adulteresses, against those who swear falsely, and against those who oppress the hired worker in his wages, the widow and the orphan, and who turn aside the sojourner, and do not fear me,' says the Lord of hosts (Malachi 3:5).
For he will judge the world, and judgment will be given to him.
David says in the fifth psalm: 'The Lord will judge the world in righteousness' (Psalm 5:8).
Joel says: 'I will gather all nations and bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat, and I will enter into judgment with them there' (Joel 3:2).
And: 'The sun and moon shall be darkened, and the stars shall withdraw their shining' (Joel 3:15).
Before him, fire shall consume, and behind him, a flame shall burn; and behind him shall be a desolate wilderness (Joel 3:3).
Peoples shall be shattered at his presence (Joel 3:16).
For the Lord dwells in Zion (Joel 3:21).
Daniel says: 'I saw in the night visions, and behold, one like the Son of Man came with the clouds of heaven, and he came to the Ancient of Days and was presented before him' (Daniel 7:13).

And to him was given dominion and glory and a kingdom, that all peoples, nations, and languages should serve him; his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom one that shall not be destroyed (Daniel 7:14).
David says: 'The Lord said to me, "You are my Son, today I have begotten you"' (Psalm 2:7).
And: 'Ask of me, and I will make the nations your heritage, and the ends of the earth your possession' (Psalm 2:8).
And again: 'God arose to establish judgment, to save all the meek of the earth' (Psalm 76:9).
The memorial of man shall perish.
translator_notes: The source begins mid-sentence with 'καὶ κόπτετε καὶ μὴ φείσησθε καὶ μὴ ἐλεήσητε' and ends with 'ἐνθύμιον ἀνθρώπου'.
The Greek text of 92.1 is: Ησαϊας λέγει· Λούσασθε, καθαροὶ γίνεσθε, ἀφέλετε τὰς πονηρίας ὑμῶν ἀπὸ τῶν ψυχῶν ὑμῶν ἀπέναντι τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν μου.

The Greek text of 92.2 is: Καὶ πάλιν τρανώτερον· Τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἐπιλάμψει ὁ Θεὸς ἐν βουλῇ μετὰ δόξης ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς τοῦ ὑψῶσαι καὶ δοξάσαι τὸ καταληφθὲν τοῦ Ισραηλ ἐν Σιων, καὶ τὸ καταλειφθὲν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ, ὅτι ἅγιοι κληθήσονται πάντες οἱ γραφέντες εἰς ζωὴν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ.
baehrens: PG 41-43; Testimonia ex divinis et sacris scripturis (Khazarzar) u03 rem mid

title: The Day of the Lord and the Faithful Remnant
english: You will confess to me. For the sun and the moon will be darkened.
I will show wonders in the heaven above and signs on the earth below—blood, fire, and vapor of smoke.
The sun will be turned into darkness and the moon into blood before the coming of the great and manifest day of the Lord.
And it will be that everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.
Again he says: The day of the Lord is near, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and thick darkness.

And the Preacher says: Rejoice, young man, in your youth, and depart anger from your heart, and remember the one who created you, until the days of your evil do not come, until the sun is not darkened and the moon is not darkened and the stars are not darkened, and those who see in the windows are not darkened.
And again Isaiah says: And the heavens will be rolled up like a scroll, and all the stars will fall like leaves from a vine and like leaves fall from a fig tree.

And David in the psalm says: From the beginning, you, Lord, laid the foundation of the earth, and the works of your hands are the heavens; they will perish, but you remain; and they will all grow old like a garment, and like a covering you will roll them up, and they will be changed.
And again Isaiah says: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
And again Daniel says: After these things a king will rise up, who will do more evil than all those who have been before him, and he will speak words against the Most High.
And he will wage war against the holy ones.
Then there will be a time of tribulation, tribulation such as has not happened among humans.
And Zechariah says: They will see the son of man coming upon the clouds, and tribes will mourn according to tribes.
And David in the psalm says: Our God, and he will not keep silent; fire before him will be kindled and around him a very great tempest.
And Isaiah says: Then the sign of the son of man will appear, and gathering not according to glory he judges not according to glory nor according to speech he will reprove.
And Daniel says: His kingdom will not be corrupted, and to another people it will not be left.
And David in the psalm says: Your throne, O God, is to the age of the age.
And again the same says: You are the same, and your years will not fail.
baehrens: PG 41-43; Testimonia ex divinis et sacris scripturis (Khazarzar) u03 rem close
